name: India
description: India from the Indus Valley cities through the Mauryas, Guptas, Mughals and the British Raj to independence and the republic.

checkpoints.name: Indus Valley and the Vedic age
checkpoints.note: The cities of the Indus Valley flourish and fade. The Vedas are composed, and the Buddha and Mahavira teach in the Ganges plain.

checkpoints.name: Mauryas and Guptas
checkpoints.note: Chandragupta and Ashoka build India's first great empire. Under the Guptas come the decimal numbers with zero, Aryabhata's astronomy and the Kama Sutra.

checkpoints.name: Medieval kingdoms and sultanates
checkpoints.note: Chola fleets sail to Southeast Asia and temples rise across the south. The Delhi Sultanate rules the north for three centuries.

checkpoints.name: The Mughal Empire
checkpoints.note: Babur founds the Mughal Empire. Akbar unites most of India, and Shah Jahan builds the Taj Mahal.

checkpoints.name: British rule
checkpoints.note: The East India Company takes Bengal and then most of India. After the rebellion of 1857 the British crown rules, until Gandhi leads the struggle for freedom.

checkpoints.name: Independent India
checkpoints.note: India wins independence in 1947 amid the violence of Partition and becomes the largest democracy in the world, a nuclear power and the most populous country.
